summary: This is a 6-day island-hopping trip with short boat hops and sheltered swim stops. Late June brings 27-30°C air, 23-24°C sea and a calmer morning sea before the afternoon maistral wind. At mid budget, it uses family apartments with catamaran and ferry hops plus guided boat outings, which suits a solo adult with two kids better than a bareboat charter. A skippered week aboard would be a comfort upgrade at roughly €2,800 or more for the boat alone.
title: Family sailing in Croatia: Split, Hvar and Vis
weather_note: Late June: air 27-30°C, sea 23-24°C, calmer mornings and an afternoon maistral wind of 10-18 kn; rain is rare. Ivan midsummer celebrations on 23 June and the Hvar Festival may add evening events.
